changeSet.author: rostyslav
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS streets AS SELECT name, highway, ST_Length(ST_Transform(way, 4326)::geography) AS length_m FROM planet_osm_line WHERE highway IS NOT NULL AND name IS NOT NULL;

changeSet.author: rostyslav
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE streets ADD COLUMN id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY;
